subject: Milwaukee impact driver $153.99 vs. Mac Tools $229.99
summary: A bare Milwaukee M18 FUEL SURGE impact driver at $153.99 next to Mac Tools' comparable bare driver at $229.99, plus one where the truck wins.
body: Today's pick: the Milwaukee M18 FUEL SURGE 1/4" hex impact driver, tool only, is $153.99 at ToolNut. Mac Tools' MCF886 20V MAX bare impact driver is $229.99 on mactools.com. That's $76 less, about 33%. They're different tools, so check torque and battery platform before you switch.
The truck doesn't always lose. Knipex 10" Click hose clamp pliers with rotating tips are $47.57 at ToolNut. Mac's Clic R hose clamp pliers (fixed tips) are $41.99.
